source: Just Browse Notes image OCR behavior, implemented from observed Glaso Notes capabilities
purpose: Verify that the packaged Tesseract Node worker resolves its runtime dependency and recognizes text after the regenerator-runtime packaging fix.

environment.profile: Isolated command-line worker test; no user browser profile used

steps.action: Resolve regenerator-runtime/runtime from the packaged Tesseract worker directory
Start createWorker with the packaged app's unpacked Tesseract Node worker and English OCR model
steps.expected: Worker starts without a missing-module exception
steps.observed: PASS: createWorker started and completed recognition

steps.action: Recognize a generated PNG containing the text 'Just Browse OCR verification'

limitations: This validates the packaged worker execution path and text recognition, not the Notes window's operating-system clipboard paste flow.
The test was run against the unsigned macOS arm64 directory build; signing and notarization were unavailable in this environment.
